content.text: In regions where payment platforms like PayPal and Stripe are either unavailable or imposing heavy fees, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-first-principles-definitive-4|Digital Product]] creators face significant barriers to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-ebooks-nigeria-without-paypal-what-actually-how-12|selling]] their design assets. This is especially true for those in countries like Nigeria and Kenya, where access to these mainstream services is severely restricted. Fortunately, a robust [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-bitcoin-payments-digital-downloads-stripe-4|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] solution exists that allows creators to sell their ebooks, templates, and other digital products using cryptocurrency, thus bypassing traditional payment hurdles.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-every-detail-you-5. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

This infrastructure is a complete digital commerce stack that empowers creators to sell directly to their audience without relying on conventional payment processors. By utilizing tools like NOWPayments for crypto transactions and Cloudflare for hosting, creators can maintain full ownership of their data and assets. This model not only eliminates the exorbitant fees associated with platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% on every sale, but also provides creators with a sustainable way to monetize their work. With a 0.5% fee from NOWPayments, the financial advantages are clear and significant.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture is composed of several free and open-source tools that work seamlessly together to create a fully functional online store. Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages serve as the hosting solution, while backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Order management is facilitated through Supabase or Google Sheets, ensuring that creators have complete control over their inventory. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments automatically verifies the transaction on-chain, providing instant payment confirmation. This setup not only enhances efficiency but also ensures that creators can deliver their products reliably.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is designed specifically for digital creators in countries facing payment platform limitations. It caters to authors, educators, and designers selling ebooks, courses, templates, and more. The focus is on empowering these individuals by providing them with the tools and infrastructure they need to succeed in a digital marketplace. By removing the dependency on restrictive platforms, this solution allows creators to operate freely and profitably, nurturing a new wave of entrepreneurship in regions that have long been overlooked.
NOWPayments only charges 0.5% per transaction, far lower than competitors.
The Components That Make It Work Together

At the core of this infrastructure are components that each serve a distinct purpose. Hosting is handled by GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which offer reliable uptime and speed. For order processing, Supabase or Google Sheets provide a user-friendly interface for tracking sales. The use of NOWPayments ensures that creators can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. Together, these components create a cohesive system that supports automated delivery of digital products, offering a streamlined experience for both sellers and buyers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To leverage this infrastructure, start by selecting the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack based on your needs. Follow the provided documentation to set up your hosting, backend logic, and payment processing. Load your digital products into the system and configure delivery settings. Once set up, you will have a fully functional online store capable of processing cryptocurrency payments with ease. For an even more comprehensive approach, consider the Complete Builder Kit, which provides all the blueprints and templates necessary for building, deploying, and scaling your own digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can use a sovereign commerce infrastructure that leverages tools like NOWPayments for crypto payments, allowing you to bypass conventional restrictions. This setup ensures you retain ownership of your products and data while minimizing transaction fees, making it a viable solution for creators in regions underserved by traditional payment platforms.
You retain complete ownership of your data and digital products—no third-party access.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a way to sell ebooks, templates, or other digital downloads without relying on platforms like Gumroad, check out the Complete Builder Kit for $197. This kit provides all 6 blueprints and 7 templates necessary to establish your own digital store. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I accept cryptocurrency payments for my digital products?

You can accept cryptocurrency payments by integrating NOWPayments into your digital commerce stack. This solution allows you to process a variety of cryptocurrencies with minimal fees, ensuring that you retain more profit from each sale.
What are the benefits of using a sovereign commerce stack?

A sovereign commerce stack empowers you with full ownership of your digital products and customer data. It eliminates reliance on third-party platforms, reducing fees and increasing your profit margins, making it a more sustainable option for creators.
Can I automate product delivery with this setup?

Yes, you can automate product delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This allows customers to receive their digital products immediately after payment confirmation, enhancing customer satisfaction and streamlining your sales process.
What kind of products can I sell using this infrastructure?

You can sell a wide range of digital products, including ebooks, online courses, design templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. The infrastructure is flexible and scalable to accommodate various digital offerings.
Is there customer support available after deployment?
Yes, both the Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack come with 30-day support to help you navigate any challenges you may encounter during the initial setup and beyond.
Automated product delivery ensures your customers receive their purchases instantly.
